text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик is looking over at me with a
sleepy
expression...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Oh, Trainer, you're such a sweet
little
cutie-pie...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Oh my, I'm sorry. It seems I had my head
in the
clouds for a bit there...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: I need to get myself together.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
You work so hard to pick all these races
for me... I
need to try harder... to win
them...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик mumbles before slipping
back into
her drowsy reverie.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...Have I put too much on her plate? I
might need
to rethink her race schedule.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
